Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back for the chase. The players and umpires return to the park. It will be Soumya Sarkar and Tanzid Hasan to open for Bangladesh. Dhananjaya de Silva ,the offie, will start with the ball for Sri Lanka looking at two left-handed openers. Here we go!
…THE RUN CHASE…

For Bangladesh, Mustafizur Rahman and Rishad Hossain were terrific and took three apiece while Taskin Ahmed chipped in with couple in his comeback game. Bangladesh came back well after the powerplay and conceded just 71 runs in the next 14 overs, picking 7 wickets along the way. Right then, Bangladesh need 125 for the win and will be confident of chasing it down and get their first win of the tournament. Can they do it or will the Sri Lankan bowlers come hard at them? We shall find out. Join us in a bit for the second essay.

Taskin Ahmed is up for a chat. He says that it was a good start for him after an injury and they will celebrate after winning the game. Adds that he is happy with the bowling unit and says that they bounced back strongly after the powerplay. Mentions that the pitch had a bit of help for the bowlers but it was all about execution. Reckons that while batting, proper cricketing shots might help.

An outstanding bowling performance from Bangladesh has restricted Sri Lanka to just 124 for 9 in their 20 overs. Having sent into bat first, Sri Lanka started well and made 53 runs for the loss of 2 wickets in the powerplay. Pathum Nissanka top scored with 47 but threw his wicket away at the wrong time. A couple of other batters got starts but failed to kick on. Post the wicket of Nissanka, Bangladesh applied pressure by taking regular wickets and kept the scoring rate under control. Angelo Mathews tried hard in the end but could only take his side past the 120-run mark.

A low full toss on the pads. Nuwan Thushara misses his pull shot and gets hit on the pads. The batters cross for one. Bangladesh have reviewed it . The UltraEdge confirms that there is no bat involved and the ball tracking also confirms that the impact it outside the line of stumps. Sri Lanka end their innings on 124 and they will not be happy with that total.

Commentary.Commentary: Drinks! It has been a half where both the teams had their strongholds. The powerplay was dominated by the Lankans and they made sure to keep the pressure on the bowlers but also lost a couple of wickets along the way. After the powerplay, the Bangladesh bowlers pulled up their socks and restricted the runs coming off the bat. They will hope to keep the pressure on and take some quick wickets while the batters will want to build a strong partnership.

Commentary.Commentary: The pre-match formatlities are done and the match is all set to start. The umpires make their way to the middle with the match ball in their hand. The fielders take their respective position on the field. Pathum Nissanka and Kusal Mendis are the opening batters for Sri Lanka. Tanzim Hasan Sakib has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's go...

The players from both the teams walk out along with the match officals for the national anthems of their countries. The national anthem of Bangladesh will be played first followed by that of Sri Lanka.

PITCH REPORT - Natalie Germanos is pitchside she says that the game will be played on pitch 4. She gives us an idea of the dimensions here and mentions that the square boundaries are 61 and 71 meters while the straight one is 73 meters. Waqar Younis joins her and he says that the average bounce is high on this pitch and reckons that this region is more favourable to the bowlers. Adds that some leg spin will be expected with the pitch having a tinge of green as well.

Wanindu Hasaranga , the skipper of Sri Lanka says that they don't have ay specific target in their mind but will capitalise the first 6 overs. Mentions that they are playing 2 proper seamers and spinners along with 2 fast bowling all rounders.

Najmul Hossain Shanto, the captain of Bangladesh says that he expects some swing and seam. Adds that the top 4 batters will have to perform well and they have been working hard. Mentions that the pitch looks dry and hopes that the new ball will favor them

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tanzid Hasan, Soumya Sarkar, Litton Das (WK), Najmul Hossain Shanto (C), Towhid Hridoy, Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah, Rishad Hossain, Taskin Ahmed, Tanzim Hasan Sakib, Mustafizur Rahman.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Kamindu Mendis, Dhananjaya de Silva (In place of Sadeera Samarawickrama), Charith Asalanka, Angelo Mathews, Dasun Shanaka, Wanindu Hasaranga (C), Maheesh Theekshana, Matheesha Pathirana, Nuwan Thushara.
TOSS - The captains are out in the middle. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of Bangladesh. They have elected to BOWL first.

Bangladesh, on the other hand, did not have the best of preparations in the lead up to the global event. They faced USA for a three-match series, a week before the World Cup and lost it by 2-1 margin. Najmul Hossain Shanto will lead the side that has the experience of Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah, Taskin Ahmed, and Mustafizur Rahman. The likes of Tanzid Hasan, Rishad Hossain, and Towhid Hridoy have shown glimpses of their talent and will the ones to keep an eye on. Can Bangladesh start their tournament with a win or will Sri Lanka bounce back strongly? Let’s find out. Toss and team news in a bit. Stay tuned!

In their match against South Africa, the Lankans were dismissed for just 77 on a tricky wicket in New York. None of their batters were able to cross the 20-run mark. Their bowlers started well in the defence and took four South African wickets but the Proteas batted sensibly and got home in the 17th over. Sri Lanka will hope to bounce back and get a win against their neighbours, Bangladesh

Hello and a warm welcome to our coverage of Match 15 in the ICC T20 World Cup, 2024. Sri Lanka are taking on Bangladesh at the Grand Prairie Stadium in Dallas, Texas. Sri Lanka suffered a defeat against South Africa in their first game of the tournament while Bangladesh are playing their maiden game of the competition.
... MATCH DAY ...

The 15th T20 World Cup match at Grand Prairie Stadium in Dallas will pit Bangladesh versus Sri Lanka in the group D contest. Since both teams have recently struggled, they will hope to take advantage of the chance to gain significant ground early in the competition. With four victories and one defeat in their last five head-to-head meetings with Bangladesh, Sri Lanka has dominated. After losing a T20I series to what was thought to be a weaker opponent, the USA, Bangladesh will need to quickly address their issues. Bangladesh heavily relies on Hridoy, Hasan, and Shakib in batting, while Mustafizur Rahman and Shakib lead the bowling attack. Success against Sri Lanka will require favorable conditions and luck, especially at the toss if Bangladesh needs to pull this one. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, faced a challenging start in the World Cup opener with their lowest T20 total of 77 runs against South Africa. The pitch conditions and their decision to bat first highlighted issues in adaptability. Despite this setback, previous successes against Bangladesh and key players like Kusal Mendis and Angelo Mathews provide hope for a turnaround. Performances from Wanindu Hasaranga and Matheesha Pathirana will be crucial for Sri Lanka to secure their first win in the T20 World Cup. So, which side will come out on top? We shall find out together.
